messages:
ajay: FYI i'm kicking off an A/B rollout for model-v2 in eu-west1 at 10% traffic. want to make sure smart routing + fallback behave per-tier (free vs standard vs premium).

maria: thanks. do we mean fallback to model-v1 or to a quantized v2-mini variant? those have different perf/cost profiles.

ajay: primary fallback should be v1 for quality, fallback-to-quantized only for latency SLO breaches. goal: premium keeps v2, standard can fall back to v1 when capacity constrained. free gets routed to cheap variants.

dylan: current routing rules don't accept rollout scope beyond region-level. we have region+tier routing, but the rollout system sets percent globally. mixing them causes double-sampling problems.

nate: we hit exactly this last week: A/B assignment ignored tier override, users in premium saw the control bucket. i traced it to routing_precedence order in router service.

ajay: ideally routing precedence should be: explicit per-route override -> per-customer-tier -> region -> global rollout. if a rollout is scoped to a tier we shouldn't reassign by global A/B.

maria: +1. also quota enforcements need to account for rollout scoping: we can't let a canary blow through premium commit and then throttle by global quota and bounce to fallback unexpectedly.

dylan: propose small API change: add "rollout_scope": ["region:eu-west1","tier:premium"] to rollout proto and let router evaluate scope before sampling.

nate: sample config snippet i used to prototype:

```
{
  "rollout_id": "r-2026-02-01",
  "variant": "v2",
  "percent": 10,
  "scope": ["tier:premium","region:eu-west1"],
  "fallback_policy": ["v1:quality","v2-mini:latency"]
}
```

ajay: that looks good. how does telemetry capture scoped samples? we need visibility per-tier/region/variant so SRE/console can show rollout health by strata.

maria: console changes: add breakdown toggles (by tier/region/model-variant) + a small heatmap for request->fallback transitions. need counts of: attempted v2, served v2, fallback->v1, fallback->v2-mini, latency buckets.

dylan: router can emit tags: rollout_id, rollout_scope, decision_reason (sampled|capacity_fallback|quota_fallback). that should be enough for dashboards.

nate: edge case: if premium runs out of premium capacity and we fallback to v1, should we mark that as rollout failure or as successful fallback? product needs semantics.

ajay: want two states: "rollout_degraded" (fallback due to infra / quota) vs "rollout_controlled_fallback" (intentional policy to route cheaper variant). dashboards should surface both.

maria: can we also tie alerts: if >5% premium traffic gets capacity_fallback for >2m, page infra oncall. if >20% fallback due to sampling mismatch, that's a logic bug.

ops-bot: deploy plan scheduled: rollout r-2026-02-01 -> start 1743289520, ramp steps [10,25,50]. linked: https://ci/redwood/deploys/r-2026-02-01

ajay: one more implementation note: router should atomically evaluate scope and samples in one pass to avoid race where quota check runs before scope filter. else we produce odd assignments.

dylan: agree. i can take a patch for router_eval_order and add unit tests. i'll also add telemetry tags. estimated 2 days.

maria: i'll file console ticket for the breakdown panels and alerts. pls add example metrics names so we can wire up.

nate: i'll add an incident test case simulating premium capacity pressure to ensure fallback is logged as rollout_degraded.

ajay: thanks everyone. let's sync tomorrow after the router PR. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout r-2026-02-01 queued for start time 1743289520.
